content: Conflict resolution UI converges on side-by-side comparison (existing left, new right) with actions Keep mine/Keep both/Replace/Keep theirs/Skip/Resolve later; bold newer date and larger size, arrow between versions; modal single-conflict with Apply-to-All for batches; shadcn Dialog/Card/Button/RadioGroup block exists. Version history (newest first, author/date, view/download/restore) is the safety net; prefer new version over silent overwrite. For non-local/remote providers Merge falls back to KeepBoth to avoid destructive replace.
